sentences.en: The brave fireman rescued a boy from the burning house.
sentences.zh: 那位勇敢的消防员从燃烧的房子中救出了一个男孩。

sentences.en: Brave man as he was, he recoiled at the sight.
sentences.zh: 尽管他是个勇敢的人，在看到那幕时还是退缩了。

sentences.en: It is very brave of you to vote against the plan.
sentences.zh: 你投票反对这个计划，这非常勇敢。
